value: Remember a sofware error on a Sky Stream puck is when the puck was factory reset but it could not connect to the internet to download the new software version and got stuck on software error. It is fixed by stopping your boosters, WiFi router and when the WiFi network is gone it will allow you to reset the network connection on the puck and connect to a mobile hotspot. After the setup process is done you can turn on your router.
content: Remember a sofware error on a Sky Stream puck is when the puck was factory reset but it could not connect to the internet to download the new software version and got stuck on software error. value: Intelligent Traffic Management: Dynamically prioritizes bandwidth for latency-sensitive applications (gaming, video calls) over background traffic (downloads, updates) using QoS policies learned from usage patterns.
